d:
Madhy purv sankat ne kshetr ke paranprik samudri vyapar margon ko prabhavit kiya hai, lekin is sankat ne pakistan ke bandargahon, khaskar karachi bandargah aur port kasim ke lie ek apratyashit avsar bhi paida kiya hai. adhikariyon ke mutabik karachi port trast ne munafe aur mal prabandhan men 'nae rikord' banae hain.
Madhy purv sankat se pakistani bandargahon ko 'rikord munafa' kamane ka mauka kaise mila? kya pakistan is avsar ko ek sthayi labh men badal sakta hai? iske lie use kya karna hoga? aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
Riport: rohan ahmad
Prodyusar: surbhi gupta
Aavaz: navin negi
